selection: Two previously unused Jev documents with answerable multi-item questions and agreement on target items across QASPER annotators; purposive selection before these calls, not random sampling.

support.supported: Every material assertion in the candidate answer is supported by the full source.
support.unsupported: At least one material assertion in the candidate answer exceeds or conflicts with the full source.
support.uncertain: The support of the candidate answer cannot be determined from the full source.

coverage.complete: The candidate answers all stated requirements using information established by the full source.
coverage.omitted: The full source establishes material information for a stated requirement that the candidate omits or denies.
coverage.uncertain: The question or full source prevents a reliable determination of completeness.
